assets.suggestedAlt: Navy beans with tomato and onion in a Dutch oven and bowl, beside dried beans and a molasses carton.
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: landscape 1536x1024 recipe hero photograph for Trading Kitchen, a budget-conscious home cooking site.
Primary request: appetizing, realistic home-cooked baked beans; finished food dominates, modest kitchen ingredients and utensils support it.
Input image 1: supporting product-packaging reference ONLY. Accurately reproduce the dark brown Crosby's Fancy Molasses carton, red cap and yellow oval Crosby's logo as one small background ingredient. Do not turn the entire image into a packshot.
Scene: worn honey-brown wooden cottage kitchen table beside a softly illuminated window. Warm, welcoming natural autumn afternoon light, subdued cream wall and ordinary cotton towel. No luxury décor.
Subject: an inexpensive black cast-iron Dutch oven filled with tender small navy beans, chopped softened onion, garlic and tomato in a thick, modest reddish-brown molasses sauce. Some individual beans clearly visible; glossy yet natural food texture, not huge kidney beans and not an overly dark sticky dessert sauce. A small cream ceramic serving bowl of the beans in the foreground and a plain wooden serving spoon resting beside it. A delicate wisp of steam above the pot.
Supporting objects: small reused clear jar with dried white navy beans, one whole onion, a ripe tomato, two garlic cloves. The referenced real Crosby's Fancy Molasses carton placed naturally behind the pot, partially visible and secondary, its front reading "Crosby's" and "FANCY MOLASSES". Ingredients only, no extra toppings.
Camera: close three-quarter view, landscape 3:2, realistic editorial food photography. Food in the pot and foreground bowl fills about two-thirds of the composition. Natural depth of field with enough background detail to recognize the ingredient package. Rich but true color, natural shadows and imperfect homemade texture.
Constraints: no people, hands, meat chunks, sausages, toast, parsley, herbs, garnish, cheese, unrelated vegetables, text overlays, watermarks, health claims or endorsement claim. Only small amount of molasses as in the recipe; simple affordable pantry meal.

assets.suggestedAlt: Sliced potatoes and onions in a creamy milk sauce in a cast-iron skillet, with milk, potatoes, onion and butter nearby.
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: landscape 1536x1024 recipe hero photograph for Trading Kitchen, budget-conscious home cooking.
Primary request: a cozy, enticing and very realistic photograph of milk potatoes, faithfully following the dish: thinly sliced potatoes and onion are first fried in a little butter until beginning to turn golden, then gently simmered in milk until the potato starch makes a light cream sauce.
Scene: a modest cottage kitchen table of pale worn wood near an open window, late-autumn daylight, cream plaster wall, folded unbleached cotton tea towel. A faint blurred autumn tree visible through the window is secondary.
Subject: a seasoned black cast-iron skillet in the foreground containing irregular overlapping slices of potato with translucent onion slices. Soft ivory milk sauce clings lightly to the potato slices and pools modestly between them; a few light golden fried edges. Fine black pepper specks only. A plain wooden spoon rests partly in the skillet. Subtle translucent steam suggests serving hot. Finished food dominates the composition.
Supporting ingredients at the side and behind: a small simple ceramic pitcher of milk, two ordinary raw potatoes, half a yellow onion and one modest pat of butter on a tiny dish. An everyday butter knife on the board. No branded package needed.
Style: honest editorial home food photography, three-quarter slightly elevated view showing the food clearly, tactile potato surfaces and worn utensils, natural warm-white color balance. Landscape 3:2, roughly 1536x1024. Appetizing real homemade food, no luxury staging.
Constraints: no people, hands, cheese, browned cheese crust, gratin, gratin baking dish, herbs, parsley, chives, bacon, extra garnish, mushrooms, eggs, bread, salads, overly thick cheese-like sauce, text, logos or watermarks. This is stovetop milk potatoes, not oven-baked scalloped potatoes. Props are smaller than the dish.

assets.suggestedAlt: Golden skillet-fried cornmeal ash cakes on a plate, with cornmeal, stock and a cast-iron skillet behind.
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: landscape 1536x1024 recipe hero photograph for Trading Kitchen, affordable pantry cooking.
Primary request: realistic, inviting skillet ash cakes made from only cornmeal, water or stock, a little lard and optional salt; showcase their honest simple texture with recipe ingredients and utensils.
Scene: a modest warm cottage kitchen worktop of weathered dark wood in soft window light, gently lit cream wall in the background and a plain faded blue cotton cloth. Cozy but restrained autumn mood without seasonal ornaments.
Subject: rustic compact cornmeal patties, about 1 inch thick and palm-sized, irregular round or oval, golden with crisp toasted brown patches and visibly coarse cornmeal grain. They look like dense cornmeal cakes, not fluffy wheat pancakes, not biscuits, not muffins. Three patties on an inexpensive matte stoneware plate dominate the foreground, one torn to reveal a dense moist coarse yellow crumb. Behind, a small seasoned cast-iron skillet holds two more patties and an ordinary metal spatula rests on its edge. A faint wisp of steam rises naturally.
Supporting ingredients: a small bowl of dry coarse yellow cornmeal, an unbranded brown kraft paper bag folded open behind it, a simple small pitcher containing pale stock, and a small white crock of cooking fat with a spoon. All props secondary and faithful to the recipe.
Camera/style: close food photography at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, real surface details and natural imperfections, broad soft window light, true warm colors, landscape 3:2 around1536x1024. Finished patties take most of the attention, not the background.
Constraints: no people, hands, brand logos, health claims, eggs, flour, milk, cheese, fresh herbs, parsley, syrup, honey, fruit, sugar, garnish, corn kernels scattered on patties, dripping oil, luxury décor, captions or watermarks. Dense savory cornmeal cakes only.
